title: TUI actions: launch, approve and stop
lead: Owner wants ork to be the one app that runs relays (2026-10-20). Today the TUI is display only (S22); launch, approve, stop and retry are CLI only. Decided: #98 ui.confirm (launch and stop confirm; approve runs on one key) and #103 ui.launch-scope (approve, stop, retry and launch from the project's ready-slice list). ork retry comes from S44.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Owner wants ork to be the one app that runs relays (2026-10-20). Today the TUI is display only (S22); launch, approve and stop are CLI only (ork run, approve, stop). Decided: #98 ui.confirm (launch and stop confirm; approve runs on one key).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: - internal/tui (keys, confirm bar, help), internal/daemon client calls, tests, goldens, docs/dashboard.md.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- A key on a Needs-you row approves an awaiting-approval run with no confirmation (ui.confirm).
- A key on a paused run that has no question retries it, after a y/n confirm.
- Stop and launch show the exact command and ask y/n (Enter is No) before running.
- Launch is offered on a ready slice of the selected project: it asks the two y/n inputs (well specified, split), then shows the exact ork run command to confirm.
- A failed call shows its error code and message verbatim.
- Runs started elsewhere offer no actions (dash.external-runs).
- Golden views, colour and monochrome.
- docs/dashboard.md no longer says the action keys are not implemented.
